titulo: Why the Rich Get Richer and the Poor Stay Poor 🥚 #shorts
descripcion:
Rich vs poor mindset explained in 40 seconds: why the rich get richer and the poor stay poor 💰🥚

3 guys each get ONE golden egg:
🍳 Guy 1 eats it (spending)
👟 Guy 2 sells it for sneakers (consumer spending)
🐔 Guy 3 lets it hatch and buys more chickens (investing & compounding)

One year later, only one of them is rich. Not luck — he didn't eat his egg, he GREW it. This is the difference between rich and poor: the poor spend money, the rich invest it and let it multiply. 📈

Learn the money mindset that builds wealth: saving vs spending, assets vs liabilities, passive income and the power of compounding — explained with a funny 2D animation.

👇 Which guy are you — 🍳, 👟 or 🐔? Comment below!
